result.winner_rule: native int64 ind from locked source cache, verified against original FP64 argmin; never FP32 argmin
result.sbs_reference: common FULL70114 TRAIN-fitted SBS, evaluated on the named split
result.all_aggregation: equal weight per problem; macro raw mean_cost descriptive only

identity.winner_rule: native int64 ind verified against original FP64 argmin; never FP32 argmin

cmr_diagnostics.label_rule: continuous relative regret from native FP64 costs; lower regret should have higher support
cmr_diagnostics.score_rule: raw FP32 utility; competitive score calculated in FP64 for offline diagnostics
cmr_diagnostics.continuous_statistic: within-context regret concordance, NOT global winner AUC; unequal regret pairs only; score ties half credit
cmr_diagnostics.aggregation: mean nonempty groups within method, mean methods within problem, equal-problem macro
cmr_diagnostics.conditional_winner_rule: within TRAIN-defined contexts only; unique FP64 minimum P vs strict loser N; tied minima excluded
cmr_diagnostics.context_policy: apply frozen TRAIN bins/categories unchanged; unseen combinations excluded and counted, no coarse fallback
